The [[Imperial Agent]] [[Cipher Nine]] was assigned an '''X-70B ''Phantom''-class prototype''' to use as a base of operations during the agent's tenure with [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] and beyond.
